r: pbmtocmuwm - convert a PBM image into a CMU window manager bitmap

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pbmtocmuwm reads a portable bitmap as input and produces a CMU window manager bitmap as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pbmtocmuwm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
